description: Features as tabs; the chosen one fills the panel beside or below the tab list.

<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/showcase.ts -->
<!--
  Features behind a tab list: the chosen tab shows its text and a picture. The page keeps the chosen tab
  (`active`, empty for the first) and updates it on the `select` event. Axes: panel (split: text beside the
  picture, stack: picture below), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type FeatureTabsProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    features: Feature[];
    tabsLabel: string;
    active?: string;
    panel?: "split" | "stack";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onselect?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import Switcher from "../components/switcher.svelte";
  import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.svelte";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    features,
    tabsLabel,
    active = "",
    panel = "split",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onselect,
  }: FeatureTabsProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} tone={tone} density={density} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  <Stack gap="6" align="stretch">
    <Switcher label={tabsLabel} class="w-fit max-w-full flex-wrap">
      {#each features as f, i (f.id)}
        <SwitcherItem
          active={((f.id === active) || (((active as string) === "") && (i === 0)))}
          onclick={() => onselect?.(f.id)}
        >
          {f.title}
        </SwitcherItem>
      {/each}
    </Switcher>
    {#each features as f, i (f.id)}
      {#if ((f.id === active) || (((active as string) === "") && (i === 0)))}
        <Grid
          cols={(((panel as string) === "split") ? "1-2" : "1")}
          class="items-center gap-8"
          data-testid="tab-panel"
          role="tabpanel"
        >
          <Stack gap="4">
            <LucideIcon name={f.icon} size={24} />
            <Title as={3} size="2xl" weight="bold">
              {f.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {f.text}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <MediaFrame alt={f.title} ratio="4/3" />
        </Grid>
      {/if}
    {/each}
  </Stack>
</SectionFrame>
